gold_candidate.label: Leiomyosarcoma
for: Histology showed a malignant spindle cell neoplasm
positive immunostaining for α-smooth muscle actin, vimentin, and desmin
against: a clinical diagnosis of osteoblastic meningioma was made

champion_candidate.label: Malignant solitary fibrous tumor
for: Noncontrast CT of the head revealed a 5-cm hyperdense meningeal mass with parietal bone invasion
Cerebral angiography demonstrated a vascular tumor supplied by the middle meningeal artery
Histology showed a malignant spindle cell neoplasm
against: a clinical diagnosis of osteoblastic meningioma was made
